scope: Isolated execution of unmodified, tagged Magento FrontController public dispatch and ActionFlag methods with explicit infrastructure/dependency doubles. Not an installed Magento HTTP/integration run.
native_executed: DataObject native event payload getter/setter and Observer::getEvent
native_note: Native Event constructor is bypassed with Reflection because its observer collection is unrelated to this contract; payload uses native DataObject setters. FrontController constructor and all request-dispatch methods are invoked normally and unmodified. Magento request validation is an explicit permissive double; module Submit own POST/CSRF validation runs.
explicit_doubles: PurchasingPolicy decision and SubmitQuoteRequest persistence/mail service
not_run: Reports persistence when reporting is enabled

input_log.note: One complete timestamped Submit error, one complete timestamped Reports View error, and an initial incomplete Submit exception tail. The fixed uploaded observer has no controller getter and a blank line 34; this log is evidence of different executed instructions, not proof of OPcache as their cause.

contract.no_dispatch_effect: FrontController returns injected shared response without executing a modern action; postdispatch is suppressed.
